metadata.description: Kosher alcoholic beverages database from Star-K and CRC (cRc) kosher certification agencies. Categories: Scotch, Bourbon (American Whiskey), Tequila, Vodka, Beer.

kosher_status_buckets.certified: The agency lists the product with a recognized kosher certification. No separate per-bottle symbol-check instruction is stated.
kosher_status_buckets.approved_no_symbol: Approved by the agency based on known ingredients; no kosher symbol required on the bottle.
kosher_status_buckets.symbol_required: Approved only when the required kosher symbol appears on the particular bottle.
kosher_status_buckets.not_approved: Not approved / not recommended. Do not consume (unless an explicit vintage exception is noted).

important_notes: Star-K's list has NO category column; Star-K categories here are INFERRED from product-name keywords and may be incomplete or occasionally wrong. CRC categories are taken from the official 'Type' column.

Star-K's symbol-bearing items are expressed in its list as 'when bearing [symbol]'; these are normalized to symbol_required (must verify the symbol), not to certified. The 'certified' bucket is populated mainly from cRc rows marked 'Certified' with the Symbol-Required column blank, and from Star-K rows phrased 'Certified By [agency]'.
The 'certified' bucket means the agency lists the product with a recognized kosher certification; it does NOT assert that a physical symbol has been confirmed on any particular bottle.
Every row preserves the exact source wording in source_status_text. When in doubt, rely on source_status_text and the original website.
CRC 'Not Recommended unless purchased before Pesach <year>' are placed in not_approved; only bottles produced before that date may have been acceptable.
